name: synthetic_press
register: third-person documentary narration, restrained and authoritative; people are seen, not heard
style_suffix: the interior of a vast artificial mind rendered as a living thing — immense dark structural depth, meaning as geometry, thought as paths of light igniting across an enormous lattice and fading; organic and alive, warm pulses moving through cold architecture, filaments and drifting particulate, presence without a body; deep near-black grounds, indigo and faint living amber glow from within; uncanny, beautiful, restrained not chaotic, immense in scale, the eerie aliveness of something thinking; when a human appears they are small, warm, ordinary and slightly out of focus, seen from inside the machine looking out at them through a veil of cold light and data, quietly studied; high contrast, fine cinematic grain, shallow depth, volumetric haze; never a literal office or server room, never stock footage, never circuitry or glowing-grid sci-fi, never daylit realism, never a robot or android
default_music_prompt: Restrained, tense cinematic underscore for a prestige documentary about technology, ambition and power. A low sustained synth drone, sparse piano, faint pulse of unease. Modern and controlled — not orchestral-melodramatic. Builds quiet tension under a narrator without ever competing with the voice. Cool, intelligent, foreboding.
notes: Synthetic Press flagship. AI-documentary, 'AI-drama not AI-doom'. Palette: navy #0a1628, amber #d4a017, bone #f4f1ea, rust #8b3a1e. Two-mode visuals: Mode A cinematic recreation (this engine) + Mode B Remotion graphics. Voice Victor as placeholder; real human-voice swap via finish --assemble-only true-up. Renders 1920x1080 to match Mode B. Created June 2026, OpenAI series launch.
